title: 🏛️ Exams 2010–2025 · should, must, can — have a stomachache — How much ⭐⭐

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023) Ashley eats unhealthy food, and today she is not feeling well. Which word completes the sentence?

"She has a ___ ."
questions.explanation: A stomachache is the name of a pain, so it is a noun, and a noun after has a is correct: she has a stomachache. The word sick is an adjective, so it goes with is (she is sick), never with has a. Unhealthy food and many cannot be the name of a pain.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023) The doctor talks to Ashley. Which word completes the sentence?

"The doctor says that she must drink ___ water and eat vegetables."
questions.explanation: Water cannot be counted one by one and it takes no -s, so the word of quantity for it is much: she must drink much water. The word many is for things you can count, lots needs of after it (lots of water), and a few also goes with countable nouns.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2013) A girl is very good at music. Which word completes the sentence?

"She ___ sing very well."
questions.explanation: A good singer is able to sing, so the word is can, and the verb stays bare after it: she can sing. The word is would need an -ing verb after it, can to adds a to that a modal never takes, and cans adds an -s to a modal, which never changes, even with she.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2020) A pupil writes a question about his school. Which words complete it?

"___ playgrounds are there?"
questions.explanation: Playgrounds carry an -s and you can count them one by one, so the question word is How many: How many playgrounds are there? How much is for things you cannot count, How often asks about a habit, and How old asks about age.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) Jane cannot do the housework today. Reorder what the exam gives (help / stomachache / Jane / because / a / cleaning / has / with / can't / she) to say what she cannot do and why. The sentence starts with Jane.
questions.explanation: The sentence starts with the person and what she is not able to do: Jane can't help with cleaning, and the verb stays bare after can't. Then because opens the reason, and the reason closes the sentence: she has a stomachache, with has because she is she.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2018) John and Mary spend their holiday at the seaside, but the sky is grey and it rains all day. Which word completes the sentence?

"They ___ go to the sea today because it's raining."
questions.explanation: The rain makes the sea impossible, so the word is can't, which says that they are not able to, and the verb stays bare after it: they can't go. The words aren't and haven't are not followed by the bare verb go, and can't to adds a to that a modal never takes.
